entries.reply:
Done (not yet pushed).
1. Now "The particle's coordinates are (7) when written in terms of the epicyclic elements (Eqn. A9 of Hahn et al. 2025), where the mean angular velocity and epicyclic frequency at semimajor axis a are (8)". The citation prints as "Hahn et al. 2025", which is AASTeX's form for four authors.
2. Now "Equations (7) conserve exactly the vertical component of the particle's specific angular momentum vector, h_z = r v_theta = a^2 Omega_a, and also solve the planar equation of motion...". I kept "exactly" because the exact conservation of h_z is what makes Step 1 of 2.3 exact. Say if you want it dropped.
3. Yes: "The particle's cylindrical radius, the length of its position vector projected onto the ring plane, is r = a[1 + O(e)]".
4. Yes: M "advances with time t at the epicyclic frequency", and lambda "advances with time at the mean angular velocity".
5. Eqn. 6's lines are now numbered 6a and 6b, and the text cites 6a and 6b.
6. Done: "Equation (6b) is already first order in the small quantities, so nu(r) ~= nu(a) in it, with vertical frequency (BL94) (9) where the neglected terms are of order O(ei) and O(i^3)." The old oscillator equation z'' = -nu_a^2 z is gone. 2.2 now says "The solution of Eqn. (6b) with nu = nu_a is a sinusoid...", and the later check reads "solve z'' = -nu_a^2 z exactly", inline. From (9) on, every equation number is one lower: zvz is now (11) and i_node is (13).
I added the general points as style rule P73: number the lines of an equation the text cites, don't display an equation that only re-evaluates a parameter, and give a displayed result's source after it.
